{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Equator''''' was a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was present at the [[XQ4 Platform]] which was [[Recovery of the Sealion|attacked]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by [[Darth/Legends]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']] and was destroyed in the battle by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
